name: FA_DEPRN_TAX_NBVS_REP_T
description: FA_DEPRN_TAX_NBVS_REP_T is used to track the previous reporting year's cost, the evaluated net book value (NBV), and the theoretical NBV to calculate this reporting year's amounts for the Depreciable Assets Tax Reports.

columns.name: DEPRN_TAX_REP_NBV_ID
columns.description: NBV identification number for the Depreciable Assets Tax Reports for Japan.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Asset unique identifier in Oracle Fusion Assets.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type code for the book to which this asset belongs.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: Reporting location for asset tax report.

columns.name: YEAR
columns.description: Reporting fiscal year for asset tax report.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Asset cost on the previous year's reporting date. This amount determines whether the asset cost has increased or decreased during the reporting year.

columns.name: THEORETICAL_NBV
columns.description: Theoretical NBV on the previous year's reporting date. This amount determines this year's theoretical NBV. You must specify both the THEORETICAL_NBV and EVALUATED_NBV values, otherwise this reporting year's theoretical NBV is based on the asset cost and rate on the reporting date.

columns.name: EVALUATED_NBV
columns.description: Evaluated NBV on the previous year's reporting date. This amount determines this year's evaluated NBV. You must specify both THEORETICAL_NBV and EVALUATED_NBV values, otherwise this reporting year's evaluated NBV is based on the asset cost and rate on the reporting date.

columns.name: TAX_ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Minor category value assigned to this asset on the previous year's reporting date.

columns.name: UNITS_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Units for this location on the previous year's reporting date.

columns.name: LIFE
columns.description: Useful life of this asset on the previous year's reporting date.

columns.name: MINOR_CATEGORY
columns.description: Value of the minor category segment on January 1 of the reporting year.

columns.name: ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to set the start cost of the current year to zero.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique asset number. Can be either provided by user or generated by the system.
